_about.what: Verified numbers for the paper 'the finish dial'. Every value is copied from the artifact named in `source`; values marked 'derived' were computed for this file from the named rows.
_about.paths: git paths are relative to the repository root
_about.raw_rows_note: Per-problem rows of the single-sample edit cells are NOT in git (runs/<job>/answers.jsonl, on the laptop in /home/abay/Projects/iterate-hack-sharedsub/runs/). All 30 cells of edits/readout.json were recounted from them for this file: right and cap hits match the readout in every cell.

rl_zero_math.note: called 'RL', 'RL-Math', 'Math 3.1' in the repo; its tokenizer and chat template are used for every model

token_cap.unit: generated tokens; a cap hit is an answer that reached the cap without the stop token

grader.function: studies/rlneurons/lib/rln4_lib.py grade_v3 (extract_v3 + norm_v3, then math-verify equivalence)

prompt.source: studies/rlneurons/lib/n13_score.py TEMPLATE["pair1"], rendered with the RL model's chat template

cue.where: prefilled as the first tokens of the assistant answer; generation continues from it
cue.source: studies/rlneurons/data/rln4/frozen4.json prefill_ids, prefill_text; every metrics.json config.prefix_ids

hard328.built_from: studies/rlneurons/data/rln3/hard.json: 400 problems (AIME 2022-2025, AMC 23, HMMT Feb 2025, OlympiadBench)
hard328.rule: the 72 problems found in the RL-Zero-Math training prompts (exact or near match) are dropped; the 328 with flag 'none' are kept

edit_construction.matrices: 224 "layer matrices": the q, k, v, o attention projections and the gate, up, down MLP projections of each of the 32 layers (7 x 32). The other 131 of 355 tensors are the base's, unchanged.
edit_construction.top_k: per matrix, d = RL - base in float32; d_k = U_k diag(s_k) V_k^T is its top k = 8 singular directions (full SVD of that one matrix); edited matrix = base + scale * d_k
edit_construction.random_control: recipe rand8: base + scale * P diag(s_k) Q^T with the SAME 8 singular values per matrix; P, Q have orthonormal columns from the QR of Gaussian matrices (torch.Generator seed 0). Same intended norm as the top-8 edit at every size.
edit_construction.rounding: target rounded to BF16 with stochastic rounding (generator seed 0 + 1)

share_of_difference.unit: % of ||RL - base||^2 (over the 224 matrices) carried by the 8 directions

norm_at_size_1.5.unit: % of the Frobenius norm of the 224 base matrices (ref_norm 1713.79)
norm_at_size_1.5.note: BF16 rounding noise is larger than the edit at small sizes: the written change is 0.19 % with cosine 0.585 to the intended 0.11 %. The projection of the written change on the intended one is exact (effective scale 1.0000). The random control carries the same kind of rounding noise; the unedited base cell does not.

seeds.source: metrics.json / run.json config.seed, config.seed_rule of each run folder; readout.json cells.*.seed_base
seeds.note: A seed does not fix the text: vLLM batching differs between jobs (see `noise`).

setup.bootstrap: paired bootstrap over problems, 5,000 resamples, seed 0, 95 % percentile interval (studies/rlneurons/analysis/xreward_edits.py, day1_vote.py, transplant.py)

dial.set: hard328, n = 328, cue, T 1.0 / top-p 1.0, one sample per cell, seed 3000000, grader v3

weaknesses_for_the_claim: No random rank-8 cell at size 1.5 (running, work-e1b23a). The +13.7 [9.2, 18.3] is 1.5x top-8 against the random edit at size 1. Same-size contrasts exist at -1, 1, 2, 3.

Size 1.5 was the best of seven sizes on one sample of the same 328 problems. Independent draws: 198, 199, 197 (RL plain 190, 209, 194). Held-out: MATH-500 one sample (456 vs RL plain 456); fresh2026 is running (work-16773f).
Under the vote over 4 the edit is behind RL: 214 vs 221, -2.1 points [-5.2, 0.6]; the edit alone is right on 8 problems, RL alone on 15.

The dial moves finishing more than correctness at the high end: of the 77 base cap hits at 1.5x, 19 finish right, 45 finish wrong, 13 stay cut. At size 2 cap hits fall to 5 but right answers fall to 190 and right-among-finished to 58.8 % (base 64.1 %); at 3 the model degenerates (36.4 %).
Cap hits are not monotone at the top (5 at size 2, 9 at size 3) and size 0.5 gains nothing in right answers (+1.8 [-2.1, 5.8]) although cap hits fall 77 -> 50.
The edit is derived from the RL weights; and the written BF16 change is mostly rounding noise at these sizes (cosine 0.35 to 0.76 with the intended edit).

k = 64 (200) and RL-minus-random-rank-8 (195) are within noise of k = 8 at 1.5x; 1.5 vs 1 is +3.4 [-0.9, 7.6]. Single-sample contrasts under about 4-5 points are not resolved (same-seed reruns differ on 39-47 problems).
Transplant: one sample for a = 1, 3, 4 and the noise control; a chosen on the 328; no vote. fresh2026: 77 of 136 statements LM-transcribed.
